## Koko v1.0.0

First public release of **Koko** — an AI-first headless browser runtime for automation, agents, and programmable web execution.

### Highlights

- Headless browser runtime with CDP server (`koko serve`)
- TLS fingerprint impersonation via bundled `libcurl-impersonate`
- Antidetect browser profiles for automation workloads
- Zig-native runtime with embeddable architecture

### Install (macOS Apple Silicon)

```bash
brew tap ivanUri/tap
brew install koko
```

Or install directly:

```bash
brew install ivanUri/tap/koko
```

### Quick start

```bash
koko serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9222
```

Connect via CDP at `http://127.0.0.1:9222`.

### Downloads

| Platform | File |
|----------|------|
| macOS arm64 | `koko-1.0.0-darwin-arm64.tar.gz` |

### Package contents

| Path | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `bin/koko` | Browser runtime binary |
| `lib/libcurl-impersonate*.dylib` | TLS impersonation library |
| `share/koko/browser/profiles/` | Browser antidetect profiles |

### Requirements

- **macOS Apple Silicon (arm64)** for prebuilt binary
- Intel Mac: build from source — see [Build Koko](https://github.com/ivanUri/koko#build-koko)
